name: fanaye-tech-boiler-plate
description: Fanaye Technologies Enterprise Full-Stack Monorepo Boilerplate (2026 Edition)

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix && npm --prefix backend run lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run type-check && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
